children: Meta’s Muse, an AI agent for mundane chores is a viral hit, with downloads outpacing ChatGPT or Claude. It has added nearly $200 bln to the company’s value. Despite many flops —the metaverse, fines – billions of locked-in consumers are a moat that permit experimentation.
Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Jennifer Saba on Bluesky and LinkedIn.

Meta Platforms AI assistant Muse is the most downloaded app in the US Apple store, according to Sensor Tower on September 22. The agent, which handles tasks such as sending emails and booking travel, has over 2.5 million downloads since its launch on September 8.
Shares of Meta closed up 11% on September 21.
